describes: Any host that reports to GitHub Deployments (Vercel, Netlify, Render and others do, through their GitHub apps). A person pushes the branch; the engine waits for a successful deployment of HEAD and runs the e2e suite against its URL.
verify: With a deployment of HEAD finished, run the wait command once by hand from the repo root: it must print the deployment's URL and exit 0. While the deployment is still building it must print nothing. Then set "verified": true here, with the date and the host in "verifiedAgainst".
needs: gh authenticated (gh auth status) with read access to the repo's deployments
the host's GitHub app posting deployment statuses with an environment_url
the e2e suite reading its base URL from $BASE_URL

recipe.name: e2e against the GitHub deployment of HEAD

steps.note: the host's GitHub integration deploys the pushed branch

steps.wait: s=$(gh api "repos/{owner}/{repo}/deployments?sha=$(git rev-parse HEAD)&per_page=1" --jq '.[0].statuses_url // empty' 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$s" ] && gh api "$s" --jq '[.[] | select(.state=="success")][0].environment_url // empty' 2>/dev/null
steps.note: prints nothing until a deployment of HEAD reports success; stderr is discarded so an auth error is never read as a URL
